From: Evelyn White <evelyn.white@orpheus.com>

Subject: Request: exportability and tamper evidence for audit logs

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our compliance team needs a short written summary of Redwood's capabilities for producing audit-log exports that are suitable as evidentiary artifacts. Specifically:

- Supported export formats (bulk and filtered extracts)
- Ability to slice by timeframe, user, and invocation-id
- Chain-of-custody / tamper-evidence controls (hashing, signing, timestamping)
- Expected lead times and delivery mechanisms (S3, signed URL, scp)

Can you send a checklist and an example delivery package (metadata + export manifest) so our InfoSec can review? We're aiming to include this in our RFP appendix by Oct 20.

Regards,
Evelyn White
Senior Security Manager
Orpheus Financial

Attachments: none
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Evelyn White <evelyn.white@orpheus.com>
Cc: audit@orpheus.com
Date: 2026-10-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: exportability and tamper evidence for audit logs

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear list. I've attached a compact export specification CSV (export_spec_v1.csv) and our chain-of-custody template (chain_of_custody_template.pdf) for your review. High level answers below; attaching the artifacts for the InfoSec team to validate.

1) Formats:
- Bulk exports: NDJSON or compressed NDJSON (gzip) for events, CSV for metadata summaries, optional Parquet for large-scale ingestion.
- Filtered extracts: same formats; support ad-hoc slices by time range, principal (user/service), model_id, and request_id (invocation-id).

2) Slicing capabilities:
- Timeframe: arbitrary start/end with millisecond granularity.
- Principals: by API key owner, user_id, or service identity.
- Invocation/request-id: full query support; we preserve original request_id and streaming token positions to correlate token-level events.

3) Tamper-evidence & integrity:
- Each export bundle includes an export manifest (manifest.json) with SHA-256 checksums for each file.
- Optional notarization: we can provide a signed manifest (RSA-4096) and RFC-3161 timestamping on request.
- Chain-of-custody: our template documents extraction operator, system state, and transfer hashes.

4) Delivery mechanisms and timelines:
- Delivery: pre-signed S3 URL (recommended), direct SFTP, or transfer to customer-managed S3 bucket.
- Lead times: standard delivery within 5 business days for slices < 500GB; for >500GB we'd propose a 10–14 business day window and coordinate a transfer job.

5) Logs retained: retention windows are configurable per contract tier. Default hosted retention for audit records is 90 days active, with cold archival options (object store) for up to 7 years under Enterprise agreements.

If helpful, we can produce a sample export (redacted) covering a 24-hour slice and include the signed manifest. Do you want that attached to the RFP appendix?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
